title: DROP TABLE
description:
You may be wondering how to acutally delete a table? For this, you use the statement DROP TABLE. It deletes a table. BE _**VERY**_ CAREFUL WITH THIS COMMAND.
```sql
-- Syntax:
DROP TABLE table_name;
```
---
